This repository is the **full Python package**. There is no PyPI wheel yet: you install dependencies, compile `mgr_rust` with [maturin](https://www.maturin.rs/) in **release** mode (important for speed on your CPU), then `pip install -e .`.

**Requirements:** Python 3.10–3.12 (3.11 recommended) · Rust via [rustup](https://rustup.rs/) · Linux, macOS, or Windows. NumPy 1.20 and the 2.x series are both supported; if you hit a deprecation or type-promotion warning, open an issue with your `numpy` version.

## Pin a release (optional)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mofography/mofography.git && cd mofography
git checkout 2026.10.09.1
```

## One command (Linux / macOS)

**A. Fresh sandbox with [uv](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv)** (creates `.venv` in the clone):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mofography/mofography/master/scripts/install_mofography.sh | bash -s -- --mode uv-sandbox
```

**B. Active conda or venv** (installs into the Python you already activated):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mofography/mofography/master/scripts/install_mofography.sh | bash -s -- --mode pip-existing
```

Pin a release in the one-liner:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mofography/mofography/master/scripts/install_mofography.sh | bash -s -- --mode uv-sandbox --ref 2026.10.09.1
```

From an existing clone: `./scripts/install_mofography.sh --mode uv-sandbox`, or `--mode pip-existing --repo-dir .`

## Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/mofography/mofography.git
cd mofography
git checkout 2026.10.09.1   # optional
.\scripts\install_mofography.ps1
```

Further Windows details live in the [README](https://github.com/mofography/mofography#install-the-library).

## Manual steps (any OS)

```bash
conda create -n mgr_env python=3.11 -y && conda activate mgr_env   # or your venv
conda install -c conda-forge pymatgen ase dask networkx scikit-image scikit-learn plotly freud rdkit -y

git clone https://github.com/mofography/mofography.git && cd mofography
python -m pip install maturin
cd mgr_rust && maturin develop --release && cd ..
python -m pip install -e .
```

`mamba` can replace `conda` for faster solves. With pip, the `freud` package is named `freud-analysis`.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import mgr_rust, mofography as m; print(m.__version__)"
```

## After `git pull`

Rebuild the Rust extension:

```bash
cd mgr_rust && maturin develop --release
```

We do **not** ship prebuilt `mgr_rust` wheels per OS: local `--release` builds match your machine best. More on the backend: [Rust backend notes](https://github.com/mofography/mofography/blob/master/docs/rust_backend_documentation.md).

## Quick test

Run the two core calls on a CIF from the repo (the full walkthrough is [Quick start](quick_start.qmd)):

```{python}
import numpy as np
from ase.io import read
import mofography as mgr

atoms = read("examples/TestCIFs/P1-IRMOF-1.cif")
dgrid = mgr.dgrid_from_atoms_rust(atoms, spacing=0.5).astype(np.float32)
seg = mgr.do_periodic_segmentation_rust(
    dgrid, atoms, spacing=0.5, mask_thickness=0.05, h=0.2,
    min_distance=1.5, threshold_abs=1.5,
    watershed_backend="rust_det", compute_connections=True, disable_tqdm=True,
)
print(len(seg["maxima_pbc"]), "pockets")
```
